# The request gate waits for an existing error handler without taking its token

Before the initial HTTP retry loop, send_request repeatedly observes the error-handling line and waits on its shared receiver while Busy. The actual Line::status method returns Free or a cloned completion receiver without acquiring a token. This delays a new request behind an already active handler, while the later recovery/backoff branches separately acquire or reuse tokens. It does not serialize every request or reserve the line between a free observation and sending. Receiver failures propagate as protocol errors. The fixed accepted source retains this gate; no concurrent request, throttling, authentication or build test ran.

Scope: Shared Exchange protocol sender and operation-queue line status.
